findings.heading: Combinations analysis / Análise de Combinações
findings.proposition: The horizontal bars showing the frequency of each individual symptom are located to the RIGHT of the plot; the translation says they are to the LEFT ("À esquerda").
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader looking at the UpSet figure is directed to the wrong side of the plot when trying to identify the per-symptom frequency bars, and may mistake the vertical combination bars or the intersection matrix for the individual-symptom totals.

findings.heading: `UpSetR`
findings.proposition: The English offers a more efficient alternative for the yes/no to 1/0 conversion, using the `+()` function together with `across()` to change several columns at once, and links to the [Cleaning data and core functions](cleaning.qmd#clean_across) page; the whole paragraph and its accompanying code chunk are absent from the translation.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader never learns the compact `across(..., .fns = ~+(.x == "yes"))` idiom nor the cross-reference to the data-cleaning chapter, so they are left with only the five repeated per-column recodes and miss a technique the handbook expects them to reuse elsewhere.
